notes: This rule is DOCUMENT-LEVEL. Detection runs in perDocument against PropertySnapshot.networkResources. The finding fires when any resource has a mimeType starting with 'image/' that does not include 'webp' or 'avif' (the isNextGenFormat helper). The HTML markup alone cannot trigger the finding; the test harness MUST inject networkResources with the appropriate MIME type entries. The harness-supplied snapshot for fail-1 must include at least one networkResource with mimeType 'image/jpeg' (or 'image/png', 'image/gif', etc.). The harness-supplied snapshot for pass-1 must include only resources with mimeType 'image/webp' or 'image/avif'. Severity is always 'moderate'. The finding selector is ':root'.

cases.why: networkResources include two image/jpeg entries. isNextGenFormat('image/jpeg') returns false, so unoptimizedImageCount increments to 2. The evaluate() function fires wsg-image-format when unoptimizedImageCount > 0.
networkResources include only image/webp and image/avif entries. isNextGenFormat returns true for both, so unoptimizedImageCount stays 0 and no finding is generated.
